results.title: generate verb - Definition, pictures, pronunciation and usage...
results.content: to produce or create something to **generate electricity/heat/power** to **generate income/profit** We need someone to generate new ideas. * make to create or prepare something by combining materials or putting parts together; to cause something to exist or happen:She makes her own clothes. * create to make something exist or happen, especially something new that did not exist before:Scientists disagree about how the universe was created. * Make is a more general word and is more often used for physical things: you would usually make a table/dress/cake but create jobs/wealth. * produce to make things to be sold; to create something using skill:a factory that produces microchips. * generate to produce or create something, especially power, money, or ideas:to generate electricity Brainstorming is a good way of generating ideas. * form [often passive] to make something from something else; to make something into something else:Rearrange the letters to form a new word. * to make/create/develop/produce/generate/form something from/out of something. * to create/produce/generate income/profits/wealth. * to produce/generate electricity/heat/power.
